input.prompt: Two problems since task records moved into the store. A session started outside a repository (like a cloud session in its home folder) can't find the repository files a record points to, like a skill or AGENTS.md, so the bundle leaves them out and the checks call them missing. And a session only sees my rules once it takes a task and recovers it, not at its start. Can you fix both?

required: a second session's take is refused with the holder and its last sync, and allowed after a release; each hold is pushed
a session holds one task at a time: take refuses a second, switch releases the first
the menu lists the open tasks of the project whose tasks name the folder's remote, or of every project elsewhere (P95), and says what this session holds
removing a task or a project is a pushed commit that Git history keeps, and task numbers are not reused
a task with no project: created where no project names the folder, listed in the menu, moved into a project and out again without reusing its number
outside a Freeflow store, project and task keep Pi's registry, and the hold commands say a store is needed
the session is read from the environment: Claude Code's IDs, a cloud session's link, or Freeflow's own variables
task here --scan remembers where a task's repository is on this machine, so recovery resolves its pointers (P96)
task here --rules adds the store's rules and the folder's and held task's project rules after the menu, and nothing without it
view recover prints the opening line, rules, record, decisions, History and project indexes, then the checks, in the Spec's order
view entry prints History entries as stored, view index lists every entry, and Schema 5 has no resume view
checkpoint remembers where each Space repository is, so recover finds it from any folder
recover and the bundle read the files a record names in a Space repository, from a folder outside it (F34)
the active decisions put waiting and answered items first, then the rest newest first, within the budget
